displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 288BNV Evolution heat pump or 189BNV air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 32 is 3 short and 2 long
meaning: Low pressure trip. The control elevates this to fault 83 after 3 occurrences. Reset time is 6 minutes. The manual's example of the flash pattern is 3 short and 2 long for code 32, and Table 6 calls that low pressure switch open.
causes: The service manual points code 32 at the fault 83 cause list
Indoor airflow too low in cooling, or outdoor airflow too low in heating
Restriction in the filter drier, expansion device, circuits, or tubing
diySteps: In cooling, with power off, check the indoor coil for ice or debris. Also look at the outdoor coil for ice or debris
Technician: follow the fault 83 table for charge, service valves, the EXV or TXV, and the filter drier
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 32 repeats or becomes the 4-hour lockout 83. Do not add refrigerant.
sourceTitle: Bryant 288BNV heat pump / 189BNV air conditioner service manual (SM288BNV-189BNV-04)
